diagnosis: The GGML_BACKEND_PATH environment variable takes a backend shared-library file, not a directory; pointing it at /tmp/llama-libs made the loader reject the directory. The server was also mounted away from the directory containing its dynamic backend plugins.
primary_source: https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/blob/master/ggml/src/ggml-backend-reg.cpp ; ggml_backend_load_all() searches the executable/current directory for backend plugins, while GGML_BACKEND_PATH loads one out-of-tree backend file.
scope: Mount the complete existing runtime directory read-only at /tmp/runtime and execute /tmp/runtime/llama-server so adjacent CPU/CUDA backend plugins are discoverable. Remove the invalid directory-valued GGML_BACKEND_PATH. Keep CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 and only the three GPU0 device nodes.
attempt_policy: Attempt 07 first runs --list-devices in the isolated namespace. It may load the local CUDA backend but does not load a model. Start the pinned model only if the gate reports CUDA0 and no CUDA1; otherwise record a concrete runtime/isolation incompatibility and do not issue an inference request.
